name: Dane Sweeny
intro: Dane Sweeny is a surprise star from Australia. He is small, but he plays big. This is his best ever Grand Slam, one of the four biggest tournaments.
story: Dane grew up on the Sunshine Coast, near the beach. His dad Clay is his coach. Dane got into this US Open with a wild card, a special invitation. Then he beat Lorenzo Musetti, one of the seeded, top-ranked stars!

funFacts.text: He started hitting at age two with a little plastic racket.
His dad sold his cleaning business so he could travel everywhere with Dane.
His tennis life began on the beach at Mooloolaba, hitting balls with his dad.
He is 170 cm tall. That is about 5 feet 7 inches.
He uses slow, mindful breathing to stay calm on court.
He says he shows all his feelings out on the court.
This is his very first time playing at the US Open.

watchFor: Watch him dive for volleys at the net like a superhero.
